```yaml
name: Release MCP Server v1.0.0

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v1.0.0'

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install pytest[azure]

      - name: Run tests
        run: pytest

  docker-build-and-push:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Build Docker image
        run: docker build . -t getzep/mcp-server:v1.0.0

      - name: Login to Docker Hub
        uses: docker/login-action@v1
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Push Docker image
        run: docker push getzep/mcp-server:v1.0.0

  release-notes:
    needs: [build-and-test, docker-build-and-push]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Create release notes
        id: create_release_notes
        run: echo "::set-output name=release_notes::## MCP Server v1.0.0\n\n### Features\n- Multi-provider support\n- Default entity ontology\n- YAML configuration\n- Modular architecture\n- Simplified deployment\n- Enhanced node properties\n- Comprehensive testing\n\n### Breaking Changes\n- Configuration: YAML is now primary (env vars still work)\n- Default database: Changed from Neo4j to FalkorDB combined image\n- Transport: SSE deprecated - use HTTP (default) or stdio\n- Dependencies: `pytest` and `azure-identity` moved to optional\n- Migration: Update Claude Desktop config, create `config.yaml`, or keep using env vars with new file paths\n\n### Known Considerations\n- Rate limits\n- Provider compatibility\n- Database choice\n- Testing status\n- Documentation"

      - name: Create release on GitHub
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: v1.0.0
          release_name: MCP Server v1.0.0
          body: ${{ steps.create_release_notes.outputs.release_notes }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
```
